proof_body:
by
  intro f g K hf hg hfK hgK
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hfK 0)
  rw [Metric.uniformContinuous_iff] at hf hg ⊢
  intro ε hε
  have hη : 0 < ε / (2 * (K + 1)) := by positivity
  have hη2 : 2 * (K + 1) * (ε / (2 * (K + 1))) = ε := by
    field_simp
  obtain ⟨δ1, hδ1, h1⟩ := hf _ hη
  obtain ⟨δ2, hδ2, h2⟩ := hg _ hη
  refine ⟨min δ1 δ2, lt_min hδ1 hδ2, fun x y hxy => ?_⟩
  have a1 := h1 (hxy.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
  have a2 := h2 (hxy.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
  rw [Real.dist_eq] at a1 a2
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  have e : f x * g x - f y * g y = f x * (g x - g y) + (f x - f y) * g y := by ring
  rw [e]
  have b1 : |f x * (g x - g y)| ≤ K * (ε / (2 * (K + 1))) := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hfK x) a2.le (abs_nonneg _) hK
  have b2 : |(f x - f y) * g y| ≤ (ε / (2 * (K + 1))) * K := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul a1.le (hgK y) (abs_nonneg _) hη.le
  have b3 := abs_add_le (f x * (g x - g y)) ((f x - f y) * g y)
  nlinarith
target_source: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (K : ℝ), UniformContinuous f → UniformContinuous g → (∀ x, |f x| ≤ K) → (∀ x, |g x| ≤ K) → UniformContinuous (fun x => f x * g x)
